svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Multi-tenant cluster with a namespace per team
svg.desc: Multi-tenant cluster with a namespace per team. 16 components in 4 groups. Connections: Users to Ingress controller (HTTPS); Ingress controller to Pods; Ingress controller to Pods; Group team-a to RoleBinding (subject); RoleBinding to Role; Group team-b to RoleBinding (subject); RoleBinding to Role; NetworkPolicy to Pods; ResourceQuota to Pods; LimitRange to Pods; LimitRange to Pods; ResourceQuota to Pods; NetworkPolicy to Pods; Pods to Pods (denied).

text.tspan: MULTI-TENANT CLUSTER WITH A NAMESPACE PER TEAM
Each team gets a namespace with its own RBAC, a ResourceQuota, a LimitRange and a default-deny NetworkPolicy; only the ingress controller reaches their pods
